description: Read TikTok AUDIENCE performance reports by age or gender at advertiser, campaign, ad group or ad level, including delivery from eligible Smart+ campaigns. Multiple demographics return separate reports, not a joint distribution. Explicit pagination and native provider errors; no inference of configured targeting or Custom Audience membership.

adIds.description: Restrict results to these ad IDs.

adgroupIds.description: Restrict TikTok results to these ad group IDs.

advertiserId.description: Exact TikTok numeric ID, as a string.

campaignIds.description: Restrict results to these campaign IDs.

items.description: Exact TikTok numeric ID, as a string.

dataLevel.description: TikTok reporting aggregation level. Metrics and dimensions must be compatible with this level.

dimensions.description: age and/or gender, optionally with the ID matching dataLevel. Multiple demographics return separate reports, never a fabricated age × gender cross-tab.

endDate.description: Last date of the reporting period, in YYYY-MM-DD format, on or after startDate.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

metrics.description: Native AUDIENCE metric keys, e.g. spend, impressions, clicks, ctr, cpc, conversion. Provider rejects unsupported metric combinations; BASIC metric availability does not imply AUDIENCE support.

orderField.description: Provider field used to order report rows.

orderType.description: Sort direction for the selected ordering field.

page.description: Page number to request, starting at 1.

startDate.description: First date of the reporting period, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: tiktok_get_audience_report

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: tiktok get audience report
